prompt: Medium shot, 23-year-old East Asian woman, soft natural features, hair loosely down with a few strands across her cheek. Dusty lavender-grey lace set beneath an open oversized white shirt, sitting on the edge of a bed folding back the duvet, vertical 3:4 frame with subject filling about 55% of a minimalist bedroom. Bedside lamp casting a warm glow against dusk light filtering through sheer curtains, gentle shadow transition across the bedding. Photographic texture and quality: subtle ISO 400 film grain, natural skin subsurface scattering, faint stray hairs near her collarbone. Preserve: lace pattern, duvet texture. Avoid: AI-smoothed skin, unnaturally sharp fabric folds.

promptZh: 中景镜头，23 岁 东亚女性，柔和的自然面部特征，头发自然垂下，几缕发丝散落在脸颊上。白色超大款衬衫内搭灰紫色蕾丝套装，坐在床边掀开被子，3:4 竖构图，主体占据约 55% 的 极简主义卧室。床头灯投射出温暖的光芒，与透过薄纱窗帘的暮光交相辉映，床品上呈现出柔和的阴影过渡。摄影质感与质量：细腻的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，自然的皮肤次表面散射，锁骨附近有淡淡的碎发。保留：蕾丝图案、被子质感。避免：AI 磨皮后的平滑皮肤、不自然的锐利织物褶皱。
